falsifier: Final pivot-02 is one no-control core. Reject to DNF on insolvency, missing metrics, base or doubled return <=0, base Sharpe <0.75, doubled Sharpe <0.35, fewer than four positive folds, any nonpositive bull/bear/chop or long-bull/short-bear/combined-chop role, any sleeve floor failure, any team-declared A5 failure, drawdown above 0.30, Calmar below 0.40, or any other numeric gate. Controls, ablations, and neighbors cannot rescue it.
thesis: Without controls, a 0.12-gross weekly funding-pressure book can express a low-pressure long role in bull, a high-positive-pressure short role in bear, and two-sided funding-transfer/crowding normalization in chop, while avoiding the failed price-anchor mechanism's pervasive negative alpha and churn.
